Ты входишь на сайте Microsoft. Пароль вв: You sign in on the Microsoft website. You type your password only there.
Лаунчер хранит ключ входа у тебя на комп: The launcher keeps the sign-in key on your computer, encrypted.
The key is never sent to us.
Вводишь код и пароль там: You enter the code and password there
Microsoft даёт лаунчеру ключ: Microsoft gives the launcher a key
Ключ лежит у тебя, зашифрован: The key stays with you, encrypted
Лаунчер просит у Microsoft короткий код: The launcher asks Microsoft for a short code
Он стучится на login.microsoftonline.com: It contacts login.microsoftonline.com and gets a code of a few letters and digits. This is the standard Microsoft method for apps without their own sign-in page. It is called Device Code.
Ты открываешь настоящую страницу Microso: You open the real Microsoft page
Страница microsoft.com/link открывается: The microsoft.com/link page opens in your normal browser, not inside the launcher. The address and the padlock are visible, like on any website. You enter the code and sign in the same way you sign in to Outlook or Xbox. You type your password only there.
Лаунчер ждёт и спрашивает: «ну что?»: The launcher waits and asks: “done yet?”
Пока ты вводишь пароль у Microsoft, лаун: While you enter your password at Microsoft, the launcher keeps asking it: “has the person signed in yet?”. It never sees or asks for your login and password. The “yes” answer comes with a token. A token is a temporary key instead of a password: it proves that you signed in, but it cannot be used to sign in to your account again.
Ключ меняется на пропуск в Minecraft: The key is exchanged for a Minecraft pass
Токен Microsoft лаунчер по цепочке меняе: The launcher exchanges the Microsoft token step by step for Xbox Live, then XSTS, then Minecraft keys, and finally asks Mojang for your profile: nickname and skin. Every stop in this chain is a Microsoft, Xbox or Mojang server. Nobody else is involved.
Ключи ложатся в зашифрованный файл на тв: The keys go into an encrypted file on your computer
Файл называется secrets.bin. Он зашифров: The file is called secrets.bin. It is encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The encryption key is built from a random key that also stays with you and your computer’s ID. On Windows this random key is additionally protected by the DPAPI system. If you copy the files to another computer or another user, they cannot be opened.
Окно лаунчера ключей не видит: The launcher window never sees the keys
Интерфейс (то, что ты видишь на экране): The interface (what you see on screen) never receives tokens. The launcher core strips them from responses and keeps them to itself. When the interface needs to change a cape or start the game, it asks: “do this for account number 3”. The core inserts the token itself. The code has a test that forbids commands that hand tokens to the window.
К нам уходит только то, что нужно нам: Only what we need is sent to us
Запросы к серверам Millida несут только: Requests to Millida servers carry only the Millida account token. Microsoft, Xbox and Minecraft tokens are never sent to our servers. The only places they go over the network are Microsoft, Xbox and Mojang servers, and the game itself at launch.
Это не системная связка ключей, и мы так: This is not the system keychain, and we do not claim it is. On macOS and Linux the file is protected by access rights and bound to the computer. A program running as the same user on the same computer could, in theory, decrypt it. Binding to the Windows user account specifically is provided only by DPAPI.
Сама игра получает токен Minecraft при з: The game itself receives the Minecraft token at launch, this is unavoidable. A mod is ordinary Java code, and technically it can read this token. That is why you should install mods from the catalog and check them with the scanner.

Игра (файл .jar) и её библиотеки качаютс: The game (a .jar file) and its libraries download from piston-data.mojang.com and libraries.minecraft.net. The launcher takes the address, size and SHA1 fingerprint from the version description.
Sounds and textures come from resources.download.minecraft.net
Эти файлы называются ассетами. Имя каждо: These files are called assets. The name of each file is its SHA1 fingerprint, so any substitution is visible right away.
Отпечаток не совпал — файл не принимаетс: Fingerprint does not match, the file is rejected
Лаунчер считает отпечаток скачанного фай: The launcher computes the fingerprint of the downloaded file and compares it with the expected one. If it does not match, the file is rejected and never gets into the game.
Для игры нужна Java. Лаунчер берёт её у: The game needs Java. The launcher takes it from Adoptium (official Eclipse Temurin builds): first api.adoptium.net, and the file itself is in the releases on github.com. This is not Microsoft, and we do not claim it is. The backup provider is Azul, the backup file mirror is TUNA.
У Java отпечаток sha256 обязателен: Java must have a sha256 fingerprint
Нет отпечатка, нет защищённого адреса ht: No fingerprint, no secure https address, or an address not on the list means the package is rejected. The fingerprint comes from Adoptium or Azul, so the TUNA mirror cannot substitute the file: the checksum would not match.
Minecraft (клиент, библиотеки, ассеты) и: Minecraft (client, libraries, assets) comes only from Mojang servers. Java, loaders and mods do not: these are separate sources, described in the chapter about modpacks.

For our modpacks from the Millida catalog the rule is stricter: a sha512 fingerprint is required, without it the modpack is not installed. Сканер модов — это не антивирус. Он дела: The mod scanner is not an antivirus. It runs three checks: against the catalog (it recognizes a mod by its sha1 fingerprint), against a blocklist from our server (the list is kept for 6 hours; if it fails to load, the report says so) and a search for suspicious code inside the file (launching programs, obfuscated classes, nested jars). Result: “ok”, “unknown”, “suspicious” or “blocked”; a suspicious mod can be quarantined with one click. “Unknown” is neither an accusation nor a guarantee; the scanner does not read files larger than 64 MB.
